body:
_This review was posted by an AI agent (OpenHands)._

**Summary:** I read through the PR description, `README.md` (no `AGENTS.md`/`CONTRIBUTING.md` present in this repo), and the diff for all 4 changed files, then checked the surrounding code (`lib/agent-registry.ts`, `lib/backlog-meta.ts`, `lib/agent-library.ts`, `app/backlog/[agentId]/page.tsx`) to confirm consistency with existing patterns. I also ran the full verification suite locally against the head commit:

- `npm run test` → 86 passed / 1 skipped (87), including the new `tests/changelog.test.ts`
- `npm run typecheck` → clean
- `npm run lint` → clean
- `npm run build` → succeeds, `/changelog` is statically prerendered
- `next build && next start`, then manually inspected the rendered `/changelog` HTML — nav link highlights correctly, entries render newest-first, and the date/agent/author line and note format match the PR description.

**Correctness**
- `formatChangelogDate`/`buildChangelogEntries` in `lib/changelog.ts` are correct: dates are truncated to `YYYY-MM-DD` *before* sorting, so mixing bare dates and full ISO timestamps in the registry can't produce incorrect ordering. Tie-breaking by agent name (`lib/changelog.ts:96-99`) works as described.
- The `author?.trim() || UNKNOWN_AUTHOR` fallback (`lib/changelog.ts:91`) correctly handles missing/blank authors, confirmed by tests.
- `ChangelogSource`/`ChangelogSourceUpdate` are intentionally looser than `AgentUpdate`/`BacklogAgent`, and `agentLibrary`/`backlogAgents` are structurally compatible (confirmed via `tsc`), so `listChangelogEntries()` type-checks without unsafe casts.
- Only backlog-registry entries actually carry an `updates` array today (`AgentLibraryEntry` has no such field), so the "combined feed across every agent" claim is accurate but currently only ever surfaces backlog-agent updates — worth knowing, not a bug.

**Security:** No concerns — the feed is built entirely from the trusted internal YAML registry, not user input, so there's no injection/XSS surface introduced here.

**Tests:** Good coverage of the pure logic (no updates, tie-breaking, missing/blank author, date truncation, live-registry ordering invariant). No component-level test for `app/changelog/page.tsx`, but that matches the existing convention in this repo — no other page component has a dedicated render test either.

**Minor, non-blocking observations** (not requiring changes):
- `app/changelog/page.tsx:28` — the list `key` includes the array `index` in addition to `agentId`/`date`/`author`. Minor React anti-pattern, but since the page is statically rendered from build-time registry data with no client-side reordering, the risk is negligible.
- With real registry data, some update notes are very long, unformatted paragraphs, so the combined feed page can get quite long. This mirrors the existing behavior on `app/backlog/[agentId]/page.tsx`, so it's not a regression, just something to keep in mind if the registry grows.
- Empty-state copy differs cosmetically from the backlog detail page ("No updates yet." vs. "No updates yet") — purely cosmetic.

Overall this is a clean, well-tested, low-risk addition that reuses existing design tokens and data sources as described. No material issues found.

✅ APPROVED
